title: KILLAMITY
description:
KILLAMITYYou read the Necronomicon. Out loud. Like a complete dumbass.

Now the portals to Hell are open, your Mom is dead, and the only way out is to kill everything between you and the Lord of Darkness, then finger-blast him.

...With a finger gun. You point your finger like a gun and shoot him. What did you think we meant?

KILLAMITY is a crude, unapologetically badass retro FPS Bullet Heaven where you start as a sluggish nobody with a basic revolver and work your way toward becoming a hyper-fast, screen-clearing god of chaos moving at Mach 3.

50 BODIES OR 5 PENTAGRAMS. THEN NEXT MAP.Every arena is a demonic gauntlet with two ways out: kill 50 demons or hunt down and destroy 5 cursed pentagrams. Pick your poison. Keep your killstreak alive to multiply your gold, slide around corners, bounce off giant mushrooms, and leave a trail of carnage.

10 SKILLS. INFINITE STACKS. NO MERCY FOR YOUR FRAMERATE.Between arenas, dump your blood money into vending machines and upgrade yourself into an absolute monster. Health regeneration, movement speed, life leech, magazine size, jump height, multi-bullet spread, and more.

Every upgrade stacks infinitely. No level caps. No holding back. Keep stacking until the engine cries and Satan files a restraining order.

FEATURES TO DIE FOR• B-Movie Story Mode: A tight, caffeine-fueled 45-minute campaign packed with dark humor, ridiculous situations, and an absolutely unhinged trip through Hell.

• Choices Matter (Sort Of): Good Ending or Bad Ending? Your trigger finger determines the fate of the innocent. Pro tip: maybe don’t blast them.

• Endless Mode: Finished the story? Take your completely broken build into Endless Mode and throw it at ever-growing waves of hellspawn.

• A Face-Melting OST: Original heavy metal by MIEP that goes way harder than a game this cheap has any right to.

• Finger Guns: You’re fighting the Devil. You might as well finish him with a finger gun. Most games won’t let you do this.

• Steam Deck & Linux Support: Shred demons on the couch or on your penguin-powered rig.

If you want a 100-hour AAA cinematic masterpiece with photorealistic graphics, you’re on the wrong store page.

If you want a B-movie acid trip where you start with nothing and end up a God, welcome to KILLAMITY.

No AI-generated content or assets were used in this game.
description_short: Stack ridiculous power-ups infinitely in this retro-inspired FPS Bullet Heaven. Build completely broken combinations as you go from a lowly demon hunter to Satan getting a restraining order. Includes Story Mode with multiple endings and Endless Mode.
